summary: The Cancel Order Modal can be implemented: getOrder provides the status it shows, cancelOrder covers the confirmation with both documented errors, and the design has loading, error and success states. The reason length check is handled in the frontend.

mappings.rationale: GET /orders/{orderId} (api.md L31-52) returns id and status and documents 404 ORDER_NOT_FOUND; the modal shows them in layer Cancel Order Modal.
POST /orders/{orderId}/cancel (api.md L3-29) returns CANCELLED and documents 404 and 409, both shown by the error state of Cancel Order Modal.
Client-side length check on the reason field; the contract has no server-side rule for it.
